name: Op-amp input offset voltage and bias currents (validation circuit, ENGINE_QUEUE item 31)
description: Op-amp input errors (vos, ib, ios) on an LF353-class macro with the TI data sheet's typical values (VIO 5 mV, IIB 50 pA, IIO 25 pA). Stage A is the GK 800RB power-amp input idiom: an inverting stage whose only feedback is 1M in series with 0.1 uF, with a 1N4001 clamp across the pair. It has no DC feedback path, so without input errors the macro sits at the all-zero point; the offset drives the output until the clamp conducts, which gives a unique operating point. Stage B is a non-inverting gain of 101 fed from 1M, so its output DC is 101 x (vos - ib(+) x 1M) + 100k x ib(-). Stage C is an ideal (level 0) follower with vos 2 mV.

sources.title: TI LF353 data sheet (SNOSBH7): VIO 5 mV typ, IIB 50 pA typ, IIO 25 pA typ, AVD 100 V/mV, GBW 4 MHz, SR 13 V/us
